findings.title: Enum vs default-omitted create path
findings.claim: Adding Enum to optional type field (no CRD default) does not break relying on the documented 'Default is InPlaceIfPossible'.
findings.evidence: A1: RBG with rolloutStrategy.rollingUpdate present and type omitted -> admitted; stored type empty (runtime default path intact). roleinstancesets CRD enum active during test.

findings.title: Upgrade hazard for objects storing a now-invalid type
findings.claim: Pre-existing objects storing an out-of-enum type become un-updatable after CRD upgrade.
findings.evidence: T4: non-touching patch (replicas) on stored-bogus RIS succeeds. T5: re-apply of same invalid value succeeds. T6: patch to a DIFFERENT invalid value rejected. T7: self-heal invalid->valid succeeds. k8s tolerates legacy values; only NEW violations and value CHANGES are blocked. No wedging.

findings.title: Intended enum rejections land at CRD admission
findings.evidence: A3: RBG invalid rollingUpdate.type rejected with enum message. T1: fresh RIS invalid type rejected. T3: update introducing invalid type rejected. envtest: 'Should reject v1alpha2 role rolloutStrategy with invalid update type' PASS; 'Should reject RoleInstanceSet with invalid update strategy type' PASS.

findings.title: templateRef without patch reaches Ready
findings.evidence: envtest (PR-head controller, real apiserver): 'Should allow v1alpha2 templateRef without patch' -> Ready, PASS. Live cluster: deployed controller v0.8.0-0c00546d already lacks the removed check (RBG templateRef-without-patch reached Ready=True), so the relaxation is a no-op on this cluster but correct for main; the removed check is confirmed present on mergeBase via diff.

findings.title: Explicit empty type "" now rejected (side effect)
findings.evidence: A4: RBG rollingUpdate.type="" rejected by enum. Users relying on type:"" for default must omit the field instead (A1 shows omission still works). Minor behavioral change, acceptable.

findings.title: v1alpha1 left inconsistent (still requires patch)
findings.evidence: v1alpha1/roletemplate_validation.go:134 still rejects templateRef without templatePatch while v1alpha2 no longer does. Question for author whether v1alpha1 is intentionally exempt.

findings.title: No e2e; envtest unverified by author
findings.evidence: go test ./api/workloads/v1alpha2 ./pkg/reconciler -> ok. envtest 3 new cases -> 3 Passed | 0 Failed. e2e still absent for this functional change (closed by integration+live, not by adding e2e).
